subject: Next steps & ownership for ClearPath roadmap
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@clearpathhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & ownership for ClearPath roadmap

Alex / Procurement team — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the draft roadmap I promised (attached): ClearPath_MAP_v1.xlsx (owners + milestones). High-level notes: 

- Goal: pilot Redwood hosted inference for patient triage workflows; target production-window planning.
- Proposed target close: 2027-06-30 (TBD based on procurement).
- Key milestones in the attached MAP: discovery sign-off, SOC2 evidence review, integration sprint 1, pilot go-live, pricing approval.
- Proposed owners:
  - Integration & API work: Priya Malhotra (ClearPath IT) — please confirm
  - Procurement / contract: Procurement team (as listed)
  - Internal Redwood: Neha (AE) / Ben (Solutions) / Marissa (CS lead)
- Dependencies: availability of SOC2 report (we can share our SOC2 Type II evidence package), procurement review window (we flagged a June budget cycle), and a one-week integration sandbox reservation from your infra team.

As next steps:
1) Please confirm owners and any missing stakeholders by end of day Wednesday (2027-05-26).
2) Procurement: can you confirm expected decision window (we flagged 5–6 weeks) or propose a different target?
3) If you prefer, I'll schedule a 30-min follow-up to walk the MAP and alignment.

Attachment: ClearPath_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 54KB)

Thanks — I’ll hold on making any org/SLAs commitments until we have owner confirmation.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearpathhealth.com>, Priya Malhotra <p.malhotra@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & ownership for ClearPath roadmap

Neha — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick answers / updates below and I attached an annotated copy (ClearPath_MAP_v1_annotated.xlsx) with inline comments.

- Target close: we pushed it to 2027-07-15 on our side because of a late June board review; please mark as tentative.
- Owners: confirmed — Priya will own the integration work. Procurement will be our contracting lead (I’ve looped them).
- Procurement timeline: Procurement expects to confirm available budget by 2027-05-28; they requested a redline preview for SOW/pricing by end of this week if possible.
- SOC2: we’ll need to review your SOC2 evidence package; can you share the short summary + access to the SOC2 report?

Minor asks:
- Can the integration sprint be broken into two 1-week blocks instead of one 2-week block (we have resource constraints)?
- Please include a line item for estimated monthly inference cost in the MAP (approximate).

Thanks — I’ll confirm procurement’s decision date once they run the numbers.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & ownership for ClearPath roadmap

Neha — saw Alex’s notes. Two quick internal asks:

1) Can we produce a one-pager pricing brief (ballpark monthly inference cost + licensing options) by EOD Thur (2027-05-27)? Procurement asked for a redline preview and a cost estimate; we should get ahead of this.
2) Let’s update the MAP per Alex: split integration into two 1-week sprints, add an "est monthly cost" row, and set target close to 2027-07-15 but mark tentative.

I’ll take the pricing draft (I have the unit cost slides) — Marissa, can you prep the CS/resourcing note for the integration window?

Ben
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@clearpathhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & ownership for ClearPath roadmap

Alex / Procurement — following up with the updated MAP (attached) and a short checklist for outstanding items. Please review and, if possible, confirm procurement sign-off window by 2027-05-31 so we can hold the sandbox slot.

Attachment: ClearPath_MAP_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 68KB)

Outstanding checklist:
- [ ] Procurement confirms budget decision (asked date: 2027-05-28 — please confirm new date if different)
- [ ] Priya confirms integration timeline split into two 1-week sprints
- [ ] Redwood to provide SOC2 summary link and access to evidence package
- [ ] Redwood to send pricing one-pager (Ben) and resourcing note (Marissa) — ETA 2027-05-27

If it helps, here’s a 20-min slot I opened: https://calendly.com/neha-kapoor/clearpath-sync — pick any time next week and I’ll set the meeting.

Thanks again — happy to jump on a quick call to finalize owners.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
